341:t_1:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(...A voice... I hear a woman's voice...)

341:t_1:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(No... This sorrowful voice doesn't belong to $$リリーナ$$ alone...)

341:t_1:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(I feel it... People's will... their feelings, spreading out into space...)

341:t_1:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Seeking peace beyond war... And the one who will cut open that path is...)

341:t_1:13.en:
$n
「No! I... I don't want to die!!」

341:t_2:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Well, at least everyone who was there got taken aboard this transport ship.」

341:t_2:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That was close. Some of the machines would have been in real trouble if they'd been thrown straight out into open space.」

341:t_2:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「So... did you find out where we are?」

341:t_2:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like AG has an explanation for that.」

341:t_2:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Thank you all so much for gathering here despite your busy schedules.」

341:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Skip the pointless preamble and explain the situation. Now.」

341:t_2:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your anger is perfectly understandable. Then without further ado, allow me to explain.」

341:t_2:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to this ship's navigation system and my personal super-dimensional sensor, this is the center point of the galaxy.」

341:t_2:12.en:
$$スザク$$
「The center point of the galaxy...」

341:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The middle of the galaxy, then...」

341:t_2:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So we got thrown into the dead center of the galaxy, just like the rest of $c!?」

341:t_2:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's supposedly about 30,000 light-years from the galactic center to Earth, but...」

341:t_2:16.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「And we crossed that in an instant...?」

341:t_2:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One moment, please. It may be that we did not merely transfer across a physical distance.」

341:t_2:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Because while the position sensor points to the center of the galaxy, judging by the surroundings, this appears to be a place other than our galaxy, commonly called the Milky Way.」

341:t_2:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. There is a high probability that we have transferred to a different parallel world.」

341:t_2:21.en:
$$マオ$$
「Isn't that strange? Your sensor points to the center of the galaxy, doesn't it?」

341:t_2:23.en:
$$桂$$
「You're being evasive. You're a dimensional merchant who travels across parallel worlds, and you can't tell about that?」

341:t_2:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... The thing is, even we at $$ＤＥＭ$$ have not been able to grasp the center point of the galaxy...」

341:t_2:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you mean by that?」

341:t_2:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In fact, in every parallel world, the state of the center point of the Milky Way is unobservable.」

341:t_2:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This holds true for your worlds, the $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$, as well, and naturally for the world where those two fused.」

341:t_2:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The only exception I know of is the world where $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ lived.」

341:t_2:29.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The world that was under attack by $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

341:t_2:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Only there has it been confirmed that a nest of $$宇宙怪獣$$ lies at the center of the galaxy.」

341:t_2:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then does our own world, where space monsters also exist, have their nest at the galactic center too?」

341:t_2:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought so too, but at least nothing of the sort seems to be visible in this vicinity.」

341:t_2:33.en:
$$カレン$$
「So we really did transfer to a parallel world after all...」

341:t_2:34.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Hey, AG... Can we get back to Earth?」

341:t_2:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...This ship is a secondhand transport, and it is doubtful that it even has interplanetary travel capability, let alone a hyperspace navigation system...」

341:t_2:44.en:
$n
「Whatever else, call out to the surrounding area. At the same time, contact the $$ＤＥＭ$$ head office and request our rescue.」

341:t_2:45.en:
$n
「If that fails, having them send a spacetime transfer device would do. Either way, stake your pride as a dimensional merchant and figure out a way for us to get back to Earth.」

341:t_2:47.en:
$n
「Can you launch the $$ジェニオン$$? I'm going out to search the area with the machines that can still move.」

341:t_2:49.en:
$n
「It's just as I told you then, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

341:t_2:50.en:
$n
「When it comes to other people, all I can do is wait. But when it comes to myself, I'll give it everything I've got until my last moment.」

341:t_2:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「Count me in on that too, $n. We have a reason we must return to Earth.」

341:t_2:52.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Right. We don't have time to waste dragging our feet in a place like this.」

341:t_2:53.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If we were able to come here, we can surely return too.」

341:t_2:55.en:
$$カレン$$
「You can't think like that, $$テイタニア$$. At a time like this, you have to start by mustering your spirit.」

341:t_2:56.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Save your despair for after you're dead. This place is a gathering of people like that.」

341:t_2:58.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$... If you've decided to walk with $$キリコ$$, then steel yourself.」

341:t_2:59.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「This guy drags everyone around him along as he advances. Get on board.」

341:t_2:60.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Are you the same, $$クエント$$?」

341:t_2:62.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「And like you, I chose this way of life because I wanted to.」

341:t_2:64.en:
$$カレン$$
「You finally smiled, $$テイタニア$$.」

341:t_2:65.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Good grief... At least here, we won't be bored.」

341:t_2:67.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Heh... A soldier's life shaped by discipline and orders, turned overnight into a thrilling adventure in a sea of stars... That's not bad either.」

341:t_2:69.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Until the very last moment, we live with everything we have!」
